title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
description: Ten named Texas Tech spaces for studying, campus programs, recreation, and public cultural stops.

cards.title: Student Union Building
cards.subtitle: 2625 15th Street, Texas Tech campus
cards.notes: Use the building as a central meet-up point before campus events, then check its posted services, room options, and building hours.
cards.short_summary: Texas Tech’s campus community center combines events, services, and student spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: Texas Tech describes the Student Union Building as a home for the campus to come together for events, educational opportunities, and services.
cards.access_notes: Check the Student Union site for current building hours and room-access details.

cards.title: Escondido Theatre
cards.subtitle: Student Union Building, Room 001
cards.notes: Look for Student Activities Board programs here, or reserve it through the SUB process when planning an eligible organization event.
cards.short_summary: A 100-seat SUB-basement theatre used for organized campus programming.
cards.evidence_claim: Texas Tech lists Escondido Theatre as SUB room 001 with a maximum capacity of 100, and its Student Government Association schedules training there.
cards.access_notes: Programming and reservations are managed by the Student Union; availability varies by event.

cards.title: Study Room 2W5
cards.subtitle: University Library, Stacks 2
cards.notes: Reserve this four-person study room when a small group needs a shared screen, outlets, and a defined place to work together.
cards.short_summary: A reservable library group room with a smartboard and power.
cards.evidence_claim: Texas Tech Libraries lists Study Room 2W5 as a four-person study space with three outlets, one smartboard, and power available.
cards.source_title: Study Room 2W5 | Texas Tech University Libraries
cards.access_notes: Use the Libraries’ room-reservation calendar to see availability and booking rules.

cards.entity_name: Robert H. Ewalt Student Rec Center
cards.title: Robert H. Ewalt Student Rec Center
cards.subtitle: 3219 A Main Street, Texas Tech campus
cards.notes: Meet for a court sport, climbing, fitness, or other recreation after confirming member access and the day’s facility schedule.
cards.short_summary: The main recreation facility brings several indoor activity options into one building.
cards.evidence_claim: Texas Tech’s membership page lists indoor fitness space, group fitness classes, and a 53-foot indoor climbing wall among Recreation membership access.
cards.access_notes: Students who paid the University Recreation fee may use facilities for their enrolled semester; others may need membership.

cards.title: Leisure Pool
cards.subtitle: Recreational Aquatic Facilities, 3219 Main Street
cards.notes: Plan a swim or lazy-river visit with friends after checking the daily aquatics schedule and confirming your Recreation access.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor recreation pool with lap swimming, a water slide, and a lazy river.
cards.evidence_claim: Texas Tech lists the Leisure Pool as featuring a 645-foot lazy river, lap swimming, and a water slide.
cards.access_notes: Entry requires a valid TTU ID or membership; pool operations and hours change by schedule.

cards.title: Indoor Climbing Center
cards.subtitle: Robert H. Ewalt Student Rec Center
cards.notes: Bring a partner for a climbing session, and check the Recreation schedule for open hours and any required orientation details.
cards.short_summary: A 53-foot climbing wall inside Texas Tech’s recreation facilities.
cards.evidence_claim: Texas Tech’s Recreation membership information includes an Indoor Climbing Center with a 53-foot-tall rock wall.
cards.access_notes: Use is subject to Recreation facility access and the current climbing-center schedule.

cards.title: Urbanovsky Park
cards.subtitle: 1500 Flint Avenue, Texas Tech campus
cards.notes: Choose a court, the running trail, or disc-golf course for a low-key outdoor activity, then verify access through Recreation.
cards.short_summary: A campus recreation park with courts, fields, trail, and disc golf.
cards.evidence_claim: Texas Tech lists Urbanovsky Park among its athletics and recreation locations at 1500 Flint Avenue.
cards.source_title: Athletics & Recreation | Campus Locations | Texas Tech
cards.access_notes: Recreation facilities are primarily intended for student recreational and instructional use; follow posted park and facility rules.

cards.title: International Cultural Center
cards.subtitle: 601 Indiana Avenue, Texas Tech campus
cards.notes: Use the globe outside as an easy landmark, then attend a listed cultural program or arrange an eligible meeting through campus procedures.
cards.short_summary: A campus cultural-events facility marked by a large globe sculpture.
cards.evidence_claim: Texas Tech’s directions identify the International Cultural Center at 601 Indiana Avenue and note the large globe sculpture in front.
cards.source_title: Directions to the International Cultural Center | Texas Tech
cards.access_notes: Specific rooms and areas are scheduled through International Affairs; attend public programming or reserve through the applicable process.

cards.title: Museum of Texas Tech University
cards.subtitle: 3301 4th Street, Lubbock
cards.notes: Build in time for the galleries as a study-break destination, and confirm exhibition details before heading over with classmates or visitors.
cards.short_summary: A university museum offering public cultural programming near the campus core.
cards.evidence_claim: Texas Tech’s International Student Life page identifies the Texas Tech Museum at 3301 4th Street and states that admission is free.
cards.source_title: Global Techsan Welcome Days | Texas Tech
cards.access_notes: Verify current museum gallery hours and exhibition availability before visiting.

cards.title: National Ranching Heritage Center
cards.subtitle: 3121 4th Street, Lubbock
cards.notes: Walk the historic-preservation site with a friend or visiting family, using the center’s current visitor information to plan the stop.
cards.short_summary: A named Texas Tech heritage destination beside the museum district.
cards.evidence_claim: Texas Tech’s International Student Life page identifies the National Ranching Heritage Center at 3121 4th Street and states that admission is free.
cards.source_title: Global Techsan Welcome Days | Texas Tech
cards.access_notes: Verify current visitor hours, routes, and any program-specific arrangements before visiting.
